evidence.title: Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA

summary: A new study examines biases in language models by leveraging Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic's HH-RLHF dataset, employing TRL and LoRA for efficient fine-tuning. The approach aims to improve alignment and transparency in AI systems.
title: Researchers Audit Preference Biases in AI Models Using Direct Preference Optimization
